projectDescription: A Minecraft Fabric/NeoForge mod that expands food, farming, and decoration with fruit trees, new crops, fermentation, trellises, ceramic blocks, and unique food effects.
keyFeatures: Fruit trees for Apples, Oranges, Lemons, Plums, and Coconuts
Wild crops and new crop types including Passion Fruit, Leeks, and Spongekins
Trellises for decoration or growing vine crops (data-driven via datapacks)
Fermentation system unlocking Mead, Cider, Wine, and more
Custom food effects: Enrichment, Ebullience, Acidic, Restoration, Stupor
Dyeable ceramic building blocks in all 16 colors
Gristmill for milling grains into Flour
Shulker Tiffin — portable food container holding up to 64 of any food
Ancient plants from Sniffers: Hoary Apple Trees and Lapisberries
Compatibility with Nature's Spirit, Farmer's Delight, Amendments, and more
publicApiSurface: bountifulfares/trellis_plant JSON — data-driven decorative trellis plant definition
bountifulfares/trellis_crop JSON — data-driven trellis crop definition
bountifulfares/grass_seeds_interaction JSON — data-driven grass seeds interaction
MobEffect: ACIDIC — neutralizes/interacts with food chemistry
MobEffect: ENRICHMENT — bonus attack damage, movement speed, attack speed
BFBlocks registry — all blocks registered by the mod
BFItems registry — all items registered by the mod
